excerpt.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
excerpt.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

texts.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
texts.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

texts.zh: 你们帝制派或许赢得了这场战争，但帝国不会永存。自由之光迟早会重回星系！
texts.en: You Imperials may have won this war, but the Imperium cannot last forever. Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

texts.zh: 求求你们……帝国赢了，叛乱结束了。我们只求获得宽大处理。
texts.en: Please... the Imperium has won. The rebellion is over. We ask only for mercy.

texts.zh: 是我们输了。帝国比我们预期的还要强大。
texts.en: We have failed. The Imperium was stronger than predicted.
